resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

practice_tasks: Install Git and configure your username and email globally.
Create a local repository, make a few commits, and write a detailed README.md file.
Push your local repository to a new public GitHub repository and practice the pull/push workflow.

resources.title: Data Engineering 101: Introduction to Data Pipelines

practice_tasks: Map out a simple Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipeline on paper for a fictional dataset (e.g., e-commerce transactions).
Set up a free Google Cloud Console account and access the BigQuery sandbox.
Load a public CSV dataset into BigQuery and run basic SQL queries (SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY).
Set up a free MongoDB Atlas cluster and connect via the cloud shell or MongoDB Compass.
Insert a few sample JSON documents representing user profiles or product catalogs into a collection.
Practice querying, updating, and deleting documents using MongoDB query syntax.

resources.title: Google Cloud Machine Learning Crash Course

practice_tasks: Read through the core concepts of supervised vs. unsupervised learning in the ML crash course.
Write a simple Python script using Scikit-learn to train a basic linear regression or classification model on a built-in dataset.
Evaluate your model's accuracy and push your completed script and notebook to your GitHub repository from Week 1.
